pr_title: Record multispectrum review evidence for merged PR wave
lens: Master plan fit — does this PR advance the master plan or sidestep it?
fit_rationale: PR #17 is pure documentation of past PRs (#1-#11) — 7,639 additions / 0 deletions / 0 source code touched. Per [[feedback_foundry_pipeline_canonical]] the canonical agentic workflow is M01-P18 Foundry pipeline; retroactive evidence artifacts are arc-supporting (they populate the audit-chain that admission-gate-kernel and review-mergequeue-kernel both consume) but do NOT advance any masterplan-sequenced milestone. The 9 audit-chain events with verdict=ACCEPT_WITH_BLOCKING_FIXUPS (8 of 9) document 49 high-severity blockers + 148 major findings across already-merged code — evidence WITHOUT the FixupTask execution lane = paperwork that ratifies a fait accompli. The PR body claims 'machine-readable FixupTasks' are appended but ships zero corresponding code fixes; per [[feedback_automate_everything]] any mechanical sweep should be SCRIPTED not hand-emitted, and 173 files of formulaic JSON (39 lines per r2 file, all reading 'Round-2 F<N> reconciliation preserved consensus finding') is the exact tell that this was templated emission, not 11+ independent subagent invocations per the v2.2.0 doctrine.
antithesis_steelman: PR #17 IS plan-advancing: (a) the Foundry pipeline (M01-P18) explicitly requires audit-chain evidence as the trust substrate for the admission-gate and merge-queue kernels — retroactive backfill of 9 merged PRs is the ONLY way to bootstrap that substrate without rolling back history; (b) machine-readable FixupTasks ARE the canonical contract for downstream remediation waves (wave-B per [[feedback_foundry_pipeline_canonical]]), so emitting them now unblocks the automated fix lane; (c) zero-deletion zero-source posture is correct hygiene — evidence PRs MUST be additive and content-isolated from code PRs to keep blast radius reviewable; (d) the audit-chain events declare `reviewer_id_uniqueness_verified:true` + `executor_topology_compliance:VERIFIED` which is the v2.3.0 schema's compliance handshake; (e) 173 hand-emitted files is appropriate when the emission itself IS the contract — scripting the JSON would produce identical bytes but introduces a script-trust problem (who reviews the script).
tradeoff_tension: Evidence-as-contract vs evidence-as-paperwork. If wave-B (FixupTask execution) lands within the same milestone, PR #17 is the substrate that unblocks it — high value. If wave-B slips, PR #17 ossifies as an unactioned audit trail documenting 49 blockers in shipped code with NO compensating remediation — pure tech-debt-as-document. The diff itself cannot distinguish these two futures; verdict depends entirely on whether wave-B lands. Verified: no FixupTask execution PR yet exists for F-PR1-* through F-PR11-* IDs.
synthesis: Acceptable as substrate IF and ONLY IF: (1) a same-milestone wave-B PR lands that consumes the FixupTask IDs (F-PR<N>-NN) and either implements fixes or formally accepts-with-rationale per FixupTask; (2) the audit-chain consumer (admission-gate-kernel + review-mergequeue-kernel) is wired to actually read these events — verify by grep'ing for `consensus_debate_complete` in /Users/jasonlee/oyatie/crates/oya-foundry-vcs-*; (3) the v2.2.0 subagent-per-facet doctrine claim is honored by producing at least ONE genuinely distinct r1 review (not the 27-line templated shape repeated 9×9=81 times) — currently the diff shows uniform 27/24/33 line counts per facet-family which is the signature of templated emission, not independent subagent reasoning.

principle_violations.evidence: 173 hand-emitted JSON files with formulaic structure (r1 files: 24-42 lines; r2 files: uniformly 34 or 39 lines; r2 summaries all begin 'F<N> <facet_name> round-2 rebuttal for PR #<N> rechecked the primary facet evidence'). The doctrine REQUIRES mechanical work be scripted. Either (a) this WAS scripted and the PR should declare the generator + commit it, or (b) this was hand-emitted at scale, which violates the doctrine. The 'no shell scripts, no .mjs, no Python' validation claim in PR body confirms (b): hand emission without the doctrine-mandated tooling.

v2.2.0 doctrine requires per-facet SEPARATE SUBAGENT invocation ([[feedback_consensus_debate_spectrum_lens_subagents.md]] explicitly: 'never a single agent across all facets'). The r2 rebuttal artifacts are IDENTICAL in shape across all 9 PRs × 9 facets = 81 files, each 39 lines, each containing the same 'round-2 reconciliation preserved consensus finding' boilerplate with INFO severity. This is the signature of a single author producing facet-shaped templates, not 81 distinct subagent reasoning passes. Reviewer-id uniqueness is technically VERIFIED (each ID is string-unique) but the underlying reasoning is not facet-distinct, which subverts the doctrine while passing its surface check.

PR documents 49 high-severity blockers + 148 major findings in already-merged code per the audit-chain payloads. The audit-chain itself is a public contract surface (consumed by foundry-vcs-admission-gate-kernel). Adding 9 ACCEPT_WITH_BLOCKING_FIXUPS verdicts retroactively to public contract evidence WITHOUT a corresponding remediation PR is silent-regression-by-documentation: the contract now says 'these merges shipped with blockers' but no entry in the lifecycle state machine moves them to remediated/accepted-with-rationale.

PR body asserts 'Foundry pipeline M01-P18 remains canonical' — TRUE textually, but the artifacts produced are evidence-shape only with no wiring to the canonical pipeline's kernels. The admission-gate and review-mergequeue kernels listed in [[feedback_foundry_pipeline_canonical]] as wave-A landed must actually CONSUME these events; PR provides events without verifying the consumer wiring exists.

Doctrine: 'no stubs/placeholders/deferrals within scope'. The r2_rebuttal artifacts each contain placeholder-shaped findings with 'remediation: Keep the synthesis FixupTask and do not downgrade severity without a new facet-specific evidence file' — this is a placeholder for the actual rebuttal reasoning, not the reasoning itself. Each r2 file ships 3 identical INFO-severity items with identical remediation text; that IS the stub pattern.

findings: PR is 7,639 additions / 0 deletions / 173 files — purely additive evidence wave with zero source code or test code changes; correct content-isolation but zero forward motion on any masterplan-sequenced milestone.

All 9 audit-chain events use identical timestamp_unix=1778920055 and identical session_id=codex-multispectrum-review-9-prs-2026-05-16 — proves all 9 PR reviews were emitted in the SAME session in the SAME second, contradicting the v2.2.0 implication of per-facet-per-PR independent subagent dispatch.

verdict distribution: 8× ACCEPT_WITH_BLOCKING_FIXUPS, 1× ACCEPT_WITH_FIXUPS (PR #6) — 89% blocking rate on already-shipped code is a flashing red light that the original PR review process WAS lax; PR #17 documents the gap without fixing it.

PR #5 is the worst-case: 10 high-severity blockers + 45 major findings + r2_redispatch round (only PR requiring redispatch) — this is the ADR-0083 + M01-P17 PR that is foundational to the Foundry pipeline itself; documenting 10 blockers in the foundational PR without remediation is the highest-priority synthesis condition.
73 / 81 r2 files are exactly 39 lines (verified by file-size cluster in meta.json additions field) — uniformity at this scale is mechanically improbable without templated emission.

9 synthesis files vary 136-237 lines — the synthesis layer DOES show per-PR distinct reasoning even where per-facet r1/r2 files do not; the synthesis files are the genuine evidence; r1/r2 files are the schema-compliance shell around them.

PR claims 'Direct Rust cargo' validation but only invokes one app crate (oya-vcs-admission-gate-app) — does not run the gate/CI suite per [[feedback_clean_architecture_requirements]] 14 lanes, which is acceptable for an evidence-only PR but should be stated explicitly as scope-bounded validation.
Naming compliance: pr-<N>-<facet>-r<n>.json schema is consistent and justified in PR body per [[feedback_naming_justification]] doctrine — this is the one fully-doctrine-aligned dimension.
uncertainty_areas: Whether a wave-B FixupTask execution PR is already in flight in a sibling branch (would change verdict from partial-sidesteps to plan-advancing-substrate)
Whether the admission-gate-kernel and review-mergequeue-kernel actually consume `consensus_debate_complete` events from audit-chain.jsonl — needs grep across crates/oya-foundry-vcs-*

Whether the apparent uniformity of r2 files reflects a legitimate schema-template-fill operation (subagent given strict output template) vs single-author emission — the audit-chain timestamp evidence is suggestive but not dispositive
